# freshdesk_satisfaction_ratings (Data Source)

Every customer-satisfaction rating the API returns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_satisfaction_ratings" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `satisfaction_ratings`.
- `satisfaction_ratings` (Attributes List) Every satisfaction rating the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--satisfaction_ratings))

<a id="nestedatt--satisfaction_ratings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `satisfaction_ratings`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (Number) ID of the agent who handled the ticket.
- `created_at` (String) When the rating was created (RFC 3339).
- `feedback` (String) Free-text comment the customer left.
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the group that handled the ticket.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the satisfaction rating.
- `ratings` (String) Ratings keyed by question, as JSON.
- `survey_id` (Number) ID of the survey that was answered.
- `ticket_id` (Number) ID of the ticket that was rated.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rating was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the contact who left the rating.
